summary: Iteration 7 — Brivo marketing + Control Room (alerts + Instagram autopilot + DWJ/LOBA portfolio). Backend: 24/24 pytest passed (auth guards on all admin/alerts/* and admin/social/autopilot/* endpoints; alerts status/list/test/read; inquiry->alert wiring; Bland webhook->inquiry+alert; autopilot overview/shots/settings validation; run-now (manual)->draft with correct shot+image; skip cancels; edit persists; approve queues; hot-lead loop detected + hot_alerted_at set within ~90s). Frontend: portfolio DWJ & LOBA cards visible with case modals rendering KPI pods and correct 'Visit live site' hrefs (https://dwjhomeservices.com/, https://lobacatskills.com/); admin login->Alerts tab renders channel checklist (all channels correctly showing as unset/skipped), send-test-alert adds a Test alert row (5->6) and toast confirms 'RESEND_API_KEY not set / Twilio not configured'; /admin/social autopilot panel renders, mode switching auto/timed/manual works, time input appears for timed+manual, drafts show Approve/Skip buttons, all client shots (dwj-site, loba-site, ...) are visible; existing social sections (Content Queue, Cross-Poster, Client Wins, Fleet, Safety) still render. Restored autopilot: mode=auto, enabled=false.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking data-testid='autopilot-generate' (and shot buttons) did not fire the POST /admin/social/autopilot/run-now request in one Playwright run after several rapid mode switches. Backend endpoint itself is fully working (verified in pytest). Likely a residual `busy` state or React state race after two consecutive save() calls. Not reproducible reliably; low priority — recommend clearing busy on save() completion or disabling mode buttons while busy.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: harden AutopilotPanel busy-state so rapid save() -> run() clicks always dispatch the POST.
critical_code_review_comments: alerts.py: notify_inquiry correctly wraps email/sms in try/except and records to db.alerts with ref_id=inquiry.id — degrades to 'skipped: <error>' when keys unset (verified).
alerts.py: hot_lead_alert_loop uses $nin stage filter + hot_alerted_at $exists:false — idempotent per lead. Daily cap applied via count_documents on rolling 24h. Good.
social_autopilot.py: PUT /admin/social/autopilot validates mode + post_time + timezone with proper 400s (all 3 negative tests pass). Nice.
social_autopilot.py: autopilot_tick guards with `local.hour >= 6` — correct per spec; won't overpost. autopilot_date field prevents duplicate per day.
social_autopilot.py: run_now with body.slug validates against SHOTS dict -> 404. build_post uses SHOWCASE_ROTATION with used-list to avoid repeats. Good.
server.py: /api/webhooks/bland mirrors call variables.email into inquiries + fires notify_inquiry — verified end-to-end (alert appears with kind='inquiry').
Portfolio.jsx: DWJ and LOBA entries include url= properly, so CaseStudyModal renders `case-visit-{id}` anchor with target=_blank + noopener — good.
AlertsTab.jsx: KIND map covers hot_lead/inquiry/call/social_failed/test — all rendered kinds are typed. Polling every 20s; test button disables while sending — good UX.
AutopilotPanel.jsx: `busy` state is a single string; two overlapping actions could both set/clear it out of order. Consider replacing with per-action loading flags to avoid rare double-click race.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (portfolio + alerts + autopilot render + interact; one flaky generate-click observed once)

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_ prefixed inquiries + a TEST_hot_* lead (signal_score=95) to prove hot-lead loop. Test drafts are all skipped (status=cancelled) at end. Autopilot settings restored to mode=auto, enabled=false via module-scoped fixture teardown.
